answer: Locks are published in pearl, expire in cedar, and haven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 138 aliases therefore needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1767 identities would post 2682 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
